notes: Refined the pointer capture section in interaction.md using learnings from 2026-07-12-pointer-capture-hygiene.md. Changes: (1) Restructured section with subheadings for capture/pointerup/pointercancel/gotchas/testing. (2) Added pointercancel handler pattern — was entirely missing. (3) Added browser auto-release gotcha — browser only auto-releases on focus loss/page unload, not during normal gesture interaction. (4) Clarified release loop rationale — iterate activePointers.keys() not a separate captured ID list, delete before loop to prevent double-release. (5) Added testing pattern for verifying capture and release via overridden canvas methods. Updated table of contents to reflect new sub-sections.
